baselines.purpose: kernel-side semantic software baseline using eBPF/kprobes where the host permits it
required_artifacts: per-sample bpftrace scripts and local raw bpftrace logs under results/experiments/35t/35t-ebpf-baseline-20260523
per-sample event count and conservative end-to-end overhead summary
reproduction_commands: docker compose -f docker-compose.toolchain.yml run --rm --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --cap-add SYS_PTRACE linux-behavior bash -lc '<mount tracefs/debugfs and run bpftrace kprobe smoke>'
pass_criteria: advanced_baseline_preflight.json reports ebpf_only READY
ebpf_baseline_summary.json reports PASS with 13/13 sample evidence
baseline_evaluation_summary.json reports ebpf_only PASS
substitution_rules: strace, software instrumentation, or hardware side-channel evidence must not be substituted for eBPF-only

baselines.purpose: QEMU TCG plugin trace baseline for simulator-side event comparison
required_artifacts: upstream qemu-riscv64 user-mode binary built with --enable-plugins
qemu-plugin.h and syscall-count plugin build transcript
per-sample plugin syscall-count output and timings under results/experiments/35t/35t-qemu-plugin-baseline-20260523
pass_criteria: qemu_plugin_build_preflight.json records system-mode plugin build/load preflight evidence

baseline_evaluation_summary.json reports qemu_plugin PASS with 13/13 sample evidence
substitution_rules: QEMU-plugin syscall-count evidence is a simulator software baseline and must not be substituted for hardware trace, DBI, or real malware evidence

baselines.purpose: source-level software instrumentation baseline using gcc -finstrument-functions

substitution_rules: this source-level instrumentation is not a DBI, eBPF, or QEMU-plugin substitute
